name: ProBonoMatterTracker
tagline: Run the whole law-firm pro bono programme – intake, means test, conflicts, hours targets and impact – in one Power Apps control.
description: Full-app PCF component for law firms and legal clinics: pro bono intake board with means-test eligibility and recorded exceptions, conflict clearance, partner supervision and staffing, volunteer hours logged against per-lawyer and firm targets with pace tracking, deadlines, outcomes and impact reporting. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Means test with income limit and exception reasons
Stage rules with required fields, confirmations and undo
Volunteer hours leaderboard with per-lawyer and firm targets and pace marker
Outcomes, clients served and value-of-time impact report
Bulk assign partner / clear conflicts / move to screening, CSV export
Demo mode with fictional data, phone layout, keyboard and ARIA
react: 16.14.0 bundled (no platform libraries, no Fluent UI)
controlType: standard (ProBonoMatterTracker data-set control + ProBonoMatterTrackerPortal field control)
